info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Utility Billing Reminders-v4-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Reminders Retrieval API allows users to access important reminders related to utility billing cycles. This endpoint provides a comprehensive list of upcoming billing reminders that assist customers in managing their payments efficiently. Typically utilized by utility providers and financial applications, this API enhances user awareness and encourages timely payments. By integrating this service, developers can help consumers avoid late fees and improve their overall billing experience.

get.description: Fetches the billing reminder details to help users manage their billing schedules effectively. This endpoint provides essential information regarding upcoming billing events.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving billing reminders. This payload must be formatted as JSON and should include any necessary parameters required for processing the reminder request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning billing reminder data.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersRequest.title: Billing Reminder Request Body
ListUtilityBillingRemindersRequest.description: This schema represents the request body required for the GET operation of billing reminders. It is expected to be a string value.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersResponse_200.title: Billing Reminder Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the billing reminder.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the billing reminder.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional contextual information about the operation.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the operation.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersResponse_200.description: This schema defines the structure of the response for the GET billing reminder operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the billing reminder.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the billing reminder was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: This schema provides details about the audit for the billing reminder operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This can be useful for performance monitoring and optimization.
